root: ^Her eyes light up with excitement as she hands you the map.
^ Here, this is from my family—it's been passed down for generations! I’ve always been told it’s got... special properties. It’ll show you things that others might miss.
^She hands you a compass with a twinkle in her eye. And here’s a compass. You might need it to keep your bearings! Be careful out there, especially after what happen last night.
^Her voice becomes a little more serious, but still full of enthusiasm. I know it’s a bit strange, but... this could be the start of something incredible. A real-life mystery to solve!
